evidence: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW episodic_pause after Oct 17 fountaining with ongoing reinflation; Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting, so if volcanic then Kilauea is favored but active emission is not confirmed. [E1]

Plume trails from Big Island region: geometric upwind end 90.6 km from Kilauea and 65.0 km from Mauna Loa, and tracked 3-hr source end 38.7 km from Kilauea vs 65.3 km from Mauna Loa, favoring Kilauea over Mauna Loa. [E10, E8]

Wind at veil from 29 deg (toward ~209 SSW) matches SW extension; measured drift toward 251 deg differs by ~42 deg, within ~45 deg, supporting NE-to-SW transport. Speed 10 km/h vs wind 21.3 km/h is expected slower for source-attached centroid with moderate fit R2 0.54. [E2, E8]

No fire clusters near Big Island to explain veil; only Honolulu fire far to NW and 203-pixel Kilauea summit thermal glow. Mask is over ocean (land_frac 0.0) and does not swallow Hawaii island, so segmentation is reliable and distinct pale gray veil differs from bright white cumulus to N/E. [E12, E6]

evidence_cited.text: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW episodic_pause after Oct 17 fountaining with ongoing reinflation; Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting, so if volcanic then Kilauea is favored but active emission is not confirmed.

Plume trails from Big Island region: geometric upwind end 90.6 km from Kilauea and 65.0 km from Mauna Loa, and tracked 3-hr source end 38.7 km from Kilauea vs 65.3 km from Mauna Loa, favoring Kilauea over Mauna Loa.

Wind at veil from 29 deg (toward ~209 SSW) matches SW extension; measured drift toward 251 deg differs by ~42 deg, within ~45 deg, supporting NE-to-SW transport. Speed 10 km/h vs wind 21.3 km/h is expected slower for source-attached centroid with moderate fit R2 0.54.

No fire clusters near Big Island to explain veil; only Honolulu fire far to NW and 203-pixel Kilauea summit thermal glow. Mask is over ocean (land_frac 0.0) and does not swallow Hawaii island, so segmentation is reliable and distinct pale gray veil differs from bright white cumulus to N/E.

evidence: Volcanic origin ruled out by distance: geometric upwind end 380.4 km from Kilauea and 350.7 km from Mauna Loa, tracked source end 382.1 km and 352.0 km from summits. [E11, E9]

25-pixel FIRMS fire cluster near Honolulu (23 km, 21.3763N -158.0665W) lies ~30 km south of tracked source end (21.68N -158.035W) and between upwind end and centroid, providing a local smoke source west of central island. [E12, E9]

Wind from 26 deg (toward ~206 SSW) is broadly consistent with WSW extension from Oahu, but measured drift toward 279 deg (west) disagrees by ~73 deg with very poor fit R2 0.06, so motion does not confirm transport and lowers confidence. [E3, E9]

Mask is mostly ocean (land_frac 0.027, Oahu cover 0.102, no island swallowed) and faint translucent gray patch distinct from surrounding white clouds, consistent with thin smoke haze rather than opaque cloud. [E7]

classify.caveats: Kilauea was in episodic_pause on 2026-10-24 (episode 55 ended Oct 17, episode 56 forecast Oct 30-Nov 5) so active fountaining had ceased; residual degassing is assumed but not confirmed. Plume 1 is very extensive and diffuse and thin cirrus mixing cannot be fully excluded. Plume 2 tracking fit is very poor (R2 0.06) and drift disagrees with wind, lowering confidence.

kilauea.activity_summary: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea is currently paused after episode 55 fountaining ended on October 17. Summit reinflation continues today and the forecast for episode 56 fountaining is between October 30 and November 5, 2026. Overview: The summit eruption of Kīlauea in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused following lava fountaining in episode 55 on October 17, 2026.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
